propositions: Plan-review grounding finders only check origin/main snapshot and ignore ticket prerequisites, causing symbols that prerequisite tickets will create to be flagged missing/unverifiable and block the plan incorrectly.
The prose rule that 'a symbol created by a ticket this ticket depends_on is treated as EXISTING' exists in plan_review_G1G2.md but is not implemented or enforced in code.

A machine-parseable inline citation syntax [rebar:<ticket-id>] should be introduced and honored in two layers: Layer 1 (deterministic advisory citation parsing with both-direction edge verification) and Layer 2 (LLM agent coverage judgment via show_ticket).

Layer 1 must verify cited ticket IDs are direct upstream prerequisites via both forward edges (P.depends_on → C) and reverse edges (C.blocks → P), with errors in reverse-lookup treated as unverified to maintain fail-closed semantics.

Layer 2 must apply an LLM protocol to judge whether a cited prerequisite ticket's plan/file_impact provides the specific functionality claimed missing, crediting the citation only if coverage is affirmatively confirmed.
An uncited citation, edge-unbacked citation, or coverage-unconfirmed citation must not suppress the finding—the normal missing-symbol block still applies to maintain security.
